Hi Alice / Tom —

Thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call to make sure we’re aligned and to capture next steps on the security/compliance items you raised. If I missed anything, please flag it.

- Need for a SOC 2 Type II report and penetration test evidence before procurement sign-off
- Audit log access and exportability for security operations and EDR correlation
- Data retention controls and regional retention policies (HIPAA implications called out)
- Contractual DPA language around data processing, subprocessors, and breach notifications

Goals we discussed:
- Complete security validation (SOC 2 + pen test summary) by July 8 to feed into Acme Legal review
- Confirm audit log format, retention windows, and ability to export logs for 13 months
- DPA negotiation in parallel; aim for signature + PO by end of July if items OK

What Redwood can provide (actionable items):
1) SOC 2 Type II: I’ve attached our 2026 Type II report and pen-test summary (redacted).
2) Audit logs: Redwood provides JSON/CSV exports for request-level logs and an S3 delivery option for scheduled exports. We can share a sample export format and a short schema.
3) Retention: Default retention is 90 days for request-level artifacts, configurable up to 24 months on Dedicated/Private deployments. We documented the policy in the attached retention_summary.
4) DPA & Legal: I’ll share our standard DPA and propose a short redline window (7 business days). We can run DocuSign when ready.
